semiconductor_relevance: High — APS Materials specializes in thermal sprayed coatings specifically for semiconductor equipment, making them a relevant supplier in the industry.
summary: APS Materials, Inc. is a leader in providing thermal sprayed coatings for semiconductor equipment components, focusing on corrosion, erosion, and dielectric applications. Their offerings include a variety of metal and ceramic coatings, such as yttrium oxide and aluminum oxide, tailored for both one-off projects and high-volume production.
capabilities: Thermal sprayed coatings for semiconductor equipment
Yttrium oxide and aluminum oxide coatings
Refurbishment services for DPS chamber components
